from pathlib import Path
import json
home=Path.home()
state_root=home/'.local/state/prediction-project-executor'
campaign=home/'.local/share/prediction-project-executor/campaigns/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4'
parts=[]
for tid in ['DEV-PRED-ASTRA-RESULT-NORMALIZE-R6-20261008-N1E134']:
    p=state_root/(tid+'.json')
    parts.append('NORM_STATE_EXISTS='+str(int(p.is_file())))
    if p.is_file():
        o=json.loads(p.read_text())
        parts += ['NORM_STATUS='+str(o.get('status','')),'NORM_EXIT='+str(o.get('exit_code','')),'NORM_ERROR='+str(o.get('error','')),'NORM_REMOTE_COMMIT='+str(o.get('remote_commit',''))]
tid='A2Z-V4-ASTRA-PREBUILD-DIRECT-20261008-R4P3'
req=campaign/'requests'/(tid+'.json')
res=campaign/'model_results'/(tid+'.json')
parts += ['ASTRA_REQUEST='+str(int(req.is_file())),'ASTRA_RESULT='+str(int(res.is_file()))]
runs=campaign/'models'/'runs'
matches=sorted(runs.glob(tid+'-*'),key=lambda p:p.stat().st_mtime) if runs.exists() else []
parts.append('ASTRA_RUNS='+str(len(matches)))
if matches:
    p=matches[-1]
    parts += ['ASTRA_CHECKPOINT='+p.name,'ASTRA_COMPLETE='+str(int((p/'COMPLETE.json').is_file())),'ASTRA_WORKER='+str(int((p/'WORKER.json').is_file()))]
mstate=campaign/'models'/'STATE.json'
if mstate.is_file():
    s=json.loads(mstate.read_text())
    parts += ['MODEL_STATE='+str(s.get('state','')),'MODEL_TASK='+str(s.get('task_id','')),'MODEL_REASON='+str(s.get('reason','')),'MODEL_RETRY_AT='+str(s.get('retry_at',''))]
if res.is_file():
    o=json.loads(res.read_text())
    f=o.get('final','')
    try:r=json.loads(f) if isinstance(f,str) else (f or {})
    except Exception:r={}
    parts += ['ASTRA_DECISION='+str(r.get('decision','')),'ASTRA_PHASE='+str(r.get('phase','')),'ASTRA_BINDING='+str(r.get('binding_sha256',''))]
print('ERROR_CLASS=R4P3_CURRENT_STATE')
print('ERROR='+'|'.join(parts))
raise SystemExit(1)
